Gérer une copropriété à Laval

Laval est la troisième ville du Québec. Elle est née en 1965 du regroupement des quatorze municipalités de l'île Jésus, entre la rivière des Prairies et la rivière des Mille Îles, et son parc de copropriétés va du petit immeuble de six unités au grand ensemble de plusieurs bâtiments. Les obligations d'un syndicat, elles, sont les mêmes partout : gestion des frais de condo et des charges communes, fonds de prévoyance, assemblée générale annuelle, assurance du syndicat et évaluation du coût de reconstruction au moins tous les cinq ans.

  • Hiver : contrats de déneigement des entrées et des stationnements, négociés avec plusieurs soumissions.
  • Dégâts d'eau : entretien préventif, clapets anti-retour et une ligne d'urgence 24/7 qui répond la nuit.
  • Assurance : renouvellement, suivi des réclamations et évaluation du coût de reconstruction, inclus dans l'administration.
  • Budget : états financiers mensuels et un fonds de prévoyance calibré sur l'étude, pour éviter les cotisations spéciales.

Loi 16 : carnet d'entretien, étude du fonds de prévoyance, attestation

Tous les syndicats du Québec doivent se doter d'un carnet d'entretien et d'une étude du fonds de prévoyance d'ici août 2028, et l'attestation du syndicat, remise dans les 15 jours d'une demande, s'applique déjà. Ces documents sont réalisés par un professionnel indépendant autorisé — ingénieur, architecte, évaluateur agréé, technologue professionnel ou CPA — pas par votre gestionnaire. Nous expliquons les obligations au conseil, obtenons plusieurs soumissions, préparons les données de l'immeuble, intégrons les conclusions au budget et suivons le carnet d'entretien d'année en année, sans aucune commission sur le coût de l'étude. Notre accompagnement Loi 16 →

Managing a condo in Laval

Laval is Québec's third-largest city. It was formed in 1965 by merging the fourteen municipalities of Île Jésus, between the Rivière des Prairies and the Rivière des Mille Îles, and its condo stock ranges from small six-unit buildings to large multi-building complexes. A syndicate's obligations are the same everywhere: condo fees and common charges, the contingency fund, the annual general meeting, the syndicate's insurance and a reconstruction-cost appraisal at least every five years.

  • Winter: snow removal contracts for entrances and parking, negotiated with several quotes.
  • Water damage: preventive maintenance, backwater valves and a 24/7 emergency line that answers at night.
  • Insurance: renewal, claims follow-up and the reconstruction-cost appraisal, all part of administration.
  • Budget: monthly financial statements and a contingency fund based on the study, to avoid special assessments.

Meet the team →   Our accreditations →   Read our client reviews →

Law 16: maintenance log, contingency fund study, certificate

Every syndicate in Québec needs a maintenance log and a contingency fund study by August 2028, and the syndicate's certificate, issued within 15 days of a request, already applies. These documents are prepared by an authorized independent professional — engineer, architect, chartered appraiser, professional technologist or CPA — not by your manager. We explain the obligations to the board, obtain several quotes, prepare the building's data, build the conclusions into the budget and keep the maintenance log up to date year after year, with no commission on the cost of the study. Our Law 16 support →

Changing managers, in four steps

  1. Estimate — enter your number of units in the calculator and get your monthly rate on screen.
  2. Meeting — a free, no-obligation 30-minute consultation with your board.
  3. Transition — we collect the files, registers and access from your current manager. You have nothing to do.
  4. Management — your dedicated manager takes over and your co-owners get access to the Anacondo portal.

Yes, from 6 units. A six-unit syndicate has the same legal and accounting obligations as a large complex; Gestion Ajax was founded precisely for these syndicates. Why size changes nothing →

Yes. $29 to $37 per unit per month before taxes depending on the size of the co-ownership, all services included, no file-opening fee. See our rates →

Thirty tasks, from bookkeeping to the annual general meeting, calls for tenders and the 24/7 emergency line. See the full list →

Who will our manager be?

A dedicated manager you reach by name, backed by a team of ten professionals. Meet the team →

Law 16: maintenance log, contingency fund study, certificate

Every syndicate in Québec needs a maintenance log and a contingency fund study by August 2028, and the syndicate's certificate, issued within 15 days of a request, already applies. These documents are prepared by an authorized independent professional — engineer, architect, chartered appraiser, professional technologist or CPA — not by your manager. We explain the obligations to the board, obtain several quotes, prepare the building's data, build the conclusions into the budget and keep the maintenance log up to date year after year, with no commission on the cost of the study. Changing managers, in four steps

  1. Estimate — enter your number of units in the calculator and get your monthly rate on screen.
  2. Meeting — a free, no-obligation 30-minute consultation with your board.
  3. Transition — we collect the files, registers and access from your current manager. You have nothing to do.
  4. Management — your dedicated manager takes over and your co-owners get access to the Anacondo portal.

Frequently asked questions

Do you manage condos in Longueuil and Brossard?

Yes. We currently manage syndicates in Longueuil, Brossard, Candiac, Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu and Contrecœur, and we also serve Boucherville. See the map →

Are rates higher on the South Shore?

No. The same published tiers apply: $29 to $37 per unit per month before taxes, depending on the size of the co-ownership, all services included. See our rates →

What exactly does management include?

Thirty included tasks, from bookkeeping to general meetings, calls for tenders and the 24/7 emergency line. See the full list →

How does changing managers work?

After a free 30-minute consultation with your board, we collect the files, registers and access from your current manager. You have nothing to do.

Who will look after our building?

A dedicated manager, backed by a team of ten professionals including a chartered administrator (Adm.A). Meet the team →

Can co-owners access their documents?

Yes, through the Anacondo portal: documents, assessment notices and the co-ownership's status, available at any time. More about Gestion Ajax →
